chunks.l2:
[ptv-p01-v02] Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the Power that dwells in the heart, Kaulinī, mistress of the clan.

[ptv-p01-v04] I tell it, no doubt: swift Kaula-fruition. This Kaula rite, Goddess, abides in my heart-sky.

[ptv-p01-v05] First now: all lunar days, vowels ending in the drop; within them, by time's conjoining, moon and sun are declared.

[ptv-p01-v06] Realities from earth to person, in five groups in order — in the ka-series and the rest, ending with the ma-sound, O fair-vowed one.

[ptv-p01-v07] Fourfold the stations of wind, fire, water and their lords; above them the famous śa-series, and before, the five Brahmas.

[ptv-p01-v08] Rootless, in due order, to be known, ending in kṣa — this forthgoing declared; of all mantras and wisdoms indeed, O glorious one.

[ptv-p01-v09] This is the womb, ever told in all Tantras — joined with the fourteen and the tithi-lord's end; the third brahma, fair-hipped, the heart of Bhairava himself.
chunks.sanskrit: etad guhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulinī kulanāyikā tām me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ vrajāmy aham | śrībhairava uvāca | śṛṇu devi mahābhage uttarasyāpy anuttaram kathayāmi na saṃdehaḥ sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | kauliko 'yaṃ vidhir devi mama hṛdvyomny avasthitaḥ athādyās tithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānakāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau pṛthivyādīni tattvāni puruṣāntāni pañcasu | kramāt kādiṣu vargeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate vāyvagnisalilendrāṇāṃ dhāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam | tadūrdhve śādivikhyātam purastād brahmapañcakam amūlā tatkramā jñeyā kṣāntā sṛṣṭir udāhṛtā | sarveṣāṃ caiva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasvini iyaṃ yoniḥ samākhyātā sarvatantreṣu sarvadā | caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam | tṛtīyam brahma suśroṇi hṛdayam bhairavātmanaḥ etan nā yoginījāto nā rudro labhate sphuṭam | hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam

chunks.l2:
[ptv-p02-v11] At its right utterance, the great host of mantra-seals comes face to face at once — marked by possession of one's own body.

[ptv-p02-v12] Who remembers for a moment, in the kiss, navel-sealed — he binds body then, and the mantra-seal host, the man.

[ptv-p02-v13] Asked, he tells past and future things — even within three hours, uttering the meant god-form.

[ptv-p02-v14] Face to face he sees the undoubted, drawn by Rudra's powers; in two watches' time, sky-dwelling, remembering.

[ptv-p02-v15] By three: all mothers, mighty yoginīs, heroes, hero-lords, adepts, and the strong śākinī throng.

[ptv-p02-v16] Come, pledged, urged by Bhairava — they grant supreme fruition, whatever fruit is wished.

[ptv-p02-v17] By this the perfected will perfect, and make mantra-men perfect.

[ptv-p02-v18] Whatever in Bhairava's Tantra succeeds from this — by mantra-potency's possession-power, with no controller.
chunks.sanskrit: asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅ mantramudrāgaṇo mahān | sadyaḥ sanmukhatām eti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam muhūrtaṃ smarate yas tu cumbake nābhimudritaḥ | sa badhnāti tadā dehaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ atītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo 'sau kathayaty api | praharād yad abhipretaṃ devatārūpam uccaran sakṣāt paśyaty asaṃdigdham ākṛṣṭaṃ rudrasaktibhiḥ | praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogesvaryo mahābalāḥ | vīrā vīresvarāḥ siddhā balavān śākinīgaṇaḥ āgatya samayaṃ dattvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ | yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yad vā samīhitam anena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥ yatkiṃcid bhairave tantre sarvam asmāt prasidhyati | mantravīryasamāveśaprabhāvān na niyantriṇā adṛṣṭama.ṅdalo 'py evam yaḥ kaścid vetti tattvataḥ | sa siddhibhāg bhaven nityaṃ sa yogī sa ca dīkṣītaḥ

chunks.l2:
[ptv-p03-v20] By this mere known, all powers know; kinsman of the śākinī clan he may be, even without yoga.

[ptv-p03-v21] Ignorant of rite yet knowing ordinance, he turns to worship — having made time-fire from the first, ending in māyā, gone to the brahma-body.

[ptv-p03-v22] Śiva, whose end is endless all, deemed the supreme power-triad; whatever stands on the pure path abides within that.

[ptv-p03-v23] The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing; its mover is Śiva to be known, all-knowing highest Lord.

[ptv-p03-v24] All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — like the great power-formed tree standing in the banyan seed.

[ptv-p03-v25] So the moving-unmoving world stands in the heart-seed; who knows thus in truth — his is going-to-freedom.

[ptv-p03-v26] Initiation becomes undoubted, free of sesame-ghee offering — on crown, face, heart, secret, and image, so indeed.

[ptv-p03-v27] Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered; with each one the ten quarters' binding he should have made.
chunks.sanskrit: anena jñātamātreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ | śākinīkulasāmānyo bhaved yogaṃ vināpi hi avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati | kālāgnim āditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntam brahmadehagam śivo viśvadyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam | tadantar varti yatkiṃcic chuddhamārge vyavasthitam aṇur viśuddham acirād aisvaraṃ jñānam aśnute | taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchas tṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ | yathā nyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagad etac carācaram | evaṃ yo vetti tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī dīkṣā bhavaty asaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā | mūrdhni vaktre ca hṛdaye guhye murtau tathaiva ca nyāsaṃ krtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃsatimantritām | ekaikena diśāṃ bandhaṃ daśānām api kārayet tālatrayam purā dattvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye | śikhāsaṃkhyābhijaptena toyenābhyukṣayet tataḥ

chunks.l2:
[ptv-p04-v29] Flowers and all in order — liṅga or altar; with fourteen mutterings, a flower-seat made.

[ptv-p04-v30] There let the hero worship forthgoing, then the very seat again; casketed, let him begin the worship after.

[ptv-p04-v31] Full of all realities, graced with every limb — let the fortunate worship the goddess, twenty-seven-muttered.

[ptv-p04-v32] Then with fragrant flowers as able let him honor; with supreme devotion worship, and offer up himself.

[ptv-p04-v33] Thus the worship told — even in fire-rite this rule: who did the worship-rule, rightly remembering the seed, succeeds.

[ptv-p04-v34] Beginningless-endless seed, blossoming, gone mid-tithis — in the heart-lotus meditate the moon-ray, ever practise.

[ptv-p04-v35] Which desires he desires, them quickly may he win; though unknowing, he goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.

[ptv-p04-v36] Thus mantra-fruit got — this Rudrayāmala; from this practice: fruition and all-knowingness are won.
chunks.sanskrit: puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅgaṃ vā stha.ṅdilaṃ ca vā | caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā tatra sṛṣṭiṃ yajed vīraḥ punar evāsanaṃ tataḥ | sṛṣṭiṃ tu sampuṭīkṛtya paścād yajanam ārabhet sarvatattvasusampūrṇām sarvāvayavaśobhitām | yajed devīṃ mahābhāgā saptaviṃśatimantritām tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaiś ca yathāśaktyā samarcayet | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā svātmanaṃ ca nivedayet evaṃ yajanam ākhyātam agnikārye 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījam prasiddhyati ādyantarahitam bījaṃ vikasat tithimadhyagam | hṛtpadmāntargataṃ dhyāyet somāṃśuṃ nityam abhyasyet yān yān kāmayate kāmāṃs tān tāñ cchīghram avāpnuyāt | ajñaḥ pratyakṣatām eti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ evaṃ mantraphalāvaptir ity etad rudrayāmalam | etad abhyāsataḥ siddhiḥ sarvajñatvam avāpyate
